answer: Register a device-bound key with a notary-stamped ID in a public ledger at 40 POA per entry - one identity per window. Each epoch, sign a fresh challenge with that key; three peers re-verify it; a duplicate key slashes the deposit, voiding the payout. A clone farm needs a separate appointment and 40 POA per mask: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA and ~1,000 sequential hours before earning anything. Revoked IDs and lost keys burn the registration; no resale market for warmed-up clones. The voyage starts at the notary desk; the register is the glacier; the nectar flows only to keys carved in it.
